inspection_observations: Public check_claim_structure accepts exactly body_raw/originals. It obtains Body, verified sources, resolved selectors, complete source result and pinned schema only from private source._validated_sources. Caller decoded Body/bundle/boolean/schema/root is not an entrypoint.

Private source bundle preserves the complete former source pipeline in order and evaluates its result/output cap before returning. A patched source.MAX_OUTPUT=1 yields the original OUTPUT_BYTE_BOUND/OUTPUT_BOUNDS rather than proceeding to Claim processing.

The input schema-carrying helper has the same operational load_schema/read/shape/canonical validation sequence as the prior helper. Body evaluator loop AST is unchanged after fixed-root initializer extraction, and existing source helper ASTs are unchanged. These are inspected source identities, not a formal proof of the whole runtime.

Declaration source validation hard-codes definitions['DeclarationSource'] using the pinned schema carried from the owned Body gate, with the same bounded evaluator. There is no external root/reference resolution or second schema load. A full original shaped as ReplayBody refuses DECLARATION_SCHEMA.

Global Claim/dependency duplicate and selector/dependency ownership/primary-anchor checks complete before guard processing. Claims are visited in explicit lexical id/revision order. Complementary probes verify global reference refusal before earlier guard/cardinality errors and lexical order despite a reversed input Claim array.

Each structural Claim validates both complete guards before its REF loop, then the next Claim. Guard root-last, earlier operands and descending-index reachability checks use bounded schema-admitted arrays and no recursive project traversal or Boolean evaluation.

Every REF requires an owning exact SOURCE-target dependency and an already verified complete SourceKey. REF identity accepts all schema roles without changing their stored role. Primary anchoring separately requires SOURCE role. Borrowing another Claim's REF dependency refuses owner validation; shared selector use requires each Claim's own primary anchor.
All Claim guard/REF checks precede source parsing for every Claim. Complementary probe confirms a later Claim's missing REF refuses before an earlier selected invalid JSON source is parsed.

Per-Claim source parsing, source guard validation and the source REF union complete before structural equality. No shared-source eligibility cache exists. Source-only missing definition links are not concealed by a statement mismatch.

Scope and quote mismatch retain separate unresolved/not-checked outcomes; opaque or insufficient/unmatched-quote sources are not parsed and do not acquire source REF closure qualification. Structural zero/multiple selector cardinality refuses rather than selecting a fallback.

Statement equality compares the complete five-field closed shape with array/operand order preserved. Both sides have independently passed strict shape/type guards; Python bool/integer equivalence cannot enter valid integer node/key positions.

Result dictionaries own copied identity fields and preserve semantic_role_relevance UNPROVEN, full_reference_closure NOT_EVALUATED, semantic_completeness UNPROVEN, source_authentication UNVERIFIED, current_authority NONE and freshness UNKNOWN. No raw Statement/source/Body, accepted_result or partial Claim success escapes on refusal.
